fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-05-22, around 12:00, items including a gas stove and utensils were taken from an unattended premises at Vaigai Park Parking Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-05-22. A person named Arjun Shankar, associated with the number 9000000136, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Items reportedly taken while the premises were unattended.
